summary: An in-memory cloud backend for Ensembles, designed for testing.
rawIndexableTextContent: An in-memory cloud backend for Ensembles, designed for testing. Overview EnsemblesMemory provides MemoryCloudFileSystem, an actor-based in-memory implementation of the Ensembles CloudFileSystem protocol. It is the preferred backend for unit tests, enabling fast, deterministic sync testing without disk or network I/O.
